summary: LiveTab tests froze the server clock at 2026-10-03T16:00Z; the first paint computes the remaining time from the real Date.now() before useServerOffset lands, so two tests went red once that instant passed
evidence: CI run 37214043992 on 2026-10-04: 2 failed in LiveTab; the same file passed on 2026-10-01 and on staging CI 2026-09-24; SERVER_NOW = new Date().toISOString() makes both pass twice
